title: Correcting Recipient Details and Sending a Returned Bank Deposit Transfer Again
content:
Recipient bank details on a Bank Deposit transfer can be corrected only while its status is returned; before release a wrong detail is fixed by cancelling and booking again. A returned transfer may then be sent again within the tier's limits.

## Correcting details

- Only the correctable details may change: the beneficiary name, the beneficiary bank name and the beneficiary account number. Each is set exactly as the customer gives it.
- The customer's saved recipient record is updated by the customer in the app, never by the correction on the transfer.

## Sending again

1. **Window.** A returned transfer may be sent again only within the tier's decision window of calendar days after the funds came back. The window is counted in calendar days from the date of the returned-funds entry on the transfer's ledger, and a resend on the last day of the window is on time.
2. **Cap.** One transfer may be sent again at most the tier's maximum number of resends in total, counting every payout on the transfer numbered 2 or higher.
3. **After a return on Paloma's side.** The resend needs no correction, is free, and pays out the original amount received at the original exchange rate.
4. **After a return on the sender's side.** The resend needs the corrected details first. It pays out the US dollars recovered less the tier's handling fee, converted at a re-quoted rate (the rate sheet for the resend date with the transfer's margin rule, re-disclosed as a re-quote), and it carries the tier's resend fee as a resend fee charge against the new payout attempt, except that the tier's stated number of first sender-side resends on the transfer are free.
5. **Date.** The resend's date of availability is the resend day plus the tier's delivery time in Paloma business days.
6. **End of the road.** When the maximum number of resends is reached, or the window has passed, the transfer can only be refunded.

## Boundary and count cases (hypothetical)

| Case | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Funds came back on day R; tier window 30 days; resend on R plus 30 | on time |
| Same; resend on R plus 31 | window passed; refund only |
| Tier allowing 2 resends; payouts numbered 1, 2 and 3 already on the ledger | two resends made; no further resend |
| Bank Deposit Express, first sender-side resend | free (1 free sender-side resend on that tier) |
| Bank Deposit Express, second sender-side resend | resend fee of 2.99 |
